teaching.en: Good writers tighten their drafts by cutting every word that adds nothing.
teaching.es: Los buenos escritores ajustan sus borradores eliminando cada palabra que no aporta nada.
teaching.explanationEs: Tighten = apretar el texto: quitar lo que sobra sin perder el contenido.

teaching.en: A concise sentence says because where a wordy one says due to the fact that.
teaching.es: Una frase concisa dice «because» donde una verbosa dice «due to the fact that».
teaching.explanationEs: Concise = conciso; wordy = con más palabras de las necesarias.
segments: A concise sentence says because where a wordy
one says due to the fact that.
teaching.audioText: A concise sentence says because where a wordy one says due to the fact that.

teaching.en: She did not make a decision; she decided, and that verb is shorter and stronger.
teaching.es: Ella no tomó una decisión; decidió, y ese verbo es más corto y más fuerte.
teaching.explanationEs: Un verbo fuerte (decided) sustituye a «verbo débil + nombre» (made a decision).
segments: She did not make a decision; she decided,
and that verb is shorter and stronger.
teaching.audioText: She did not make a decision; she decided, and that verb is shorter and stronger.

teaching.en: Redundant words such as very, really and basically can usually be cut.
teaching.es: Las palabras redundantes como very, really y basically casi siempre se pueden eliminar.
teaching.explanationEs: Redundant: no añade información; quitarla no cambia el sentido.
segments: Redundant words such as very, really

feedback.es: Because dice en una palabra lo que las otras dos dicen en cuatro o cinco.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué decidió la hablante.

feedback.es: Casi se queda en casa, pero al final decidió ir al coro y se alegra.

origin.audio: I wanted to join the choir, but I was nervous. Admittedly, I almost stayed at home. In the end, I decided to go, and I am glad.

prompt.es: Escribe un texto de 130–250 palabras sobre una decisión personal, con conectores.

answer.text: Last year I had to choose between staying in my hometown and studying in another city. Admittedly, staying was the easy option: my family, my friends and my job were all there. Nevertheless, I decided to leave, because I wanted to learn something new. The choice was not simple. I made a list of the advantages and the risks, and I talked to my cousin, who moved abroad two years ago. She told me that the first months are hard, but that the experience changes you. Although I was nervous, I sent my application in March, and I was accepted in June. Now I live in a small flat near the college, and I cook for myself every day. To save money, I work at weekends. I still miss my family, but I do not regret my decision. Looking back, I think that being afraid was normal, and that the important thing was to decide. If I had stayed, I would always have wondered what might have happened.
accepted: Last year I had to choose between staying in my hometown and studying in another city. Admittedly, staying was the easy option: my family, my friends and my job were all there. Nevertheless, I decided to leave, because I wanted to learn something new. The choice was not simple. I made a list of the advantages and the risks, and I talked to my cousin, who moved abroad two years ago. She told me that the first months are hard, but that the experience changes you. Although I was nervous, I sent my application in March, and I was accepted in June. Now I live in a small flat near the college, and I cook for myself every day. To save money, I work at weekends. I still miss my family, but I do not regret my decision. Looking back, I think that being afraid was normal, and that the important thing was to decide. If I had stayed, I would always have wondered what might have happened.

Two months ago I decided to change schools. It was not an easy choice, because all my friends were in my old school. Admittedly, the new school is far from my house. Nevertheless, it has a better music programme, and music is my passion. Before deciding, I made a list of the pros and cons, and I asked my teacher for advice. She said that change can be uncomfortable, but that it often leads to growth. Although I was nervous on the first day, the other students were kind. Now I have new friends, and I practise every afternoon. To get there on time, I wake up at six. I do not regret my decision, and I would make it again if I had to choose.

feedback.es: Un párrafo sólido cuenta la decisión, pesa razones a favor y en contra con conectores variados y cierra con una reflexión.

origin.text: Escribe un texto de 130–250 palabras sobre una decisión importante que tomaste o tomarías (estudios, mudanza, club, viaje). Incluye: la situación, las razones a favor y en contra, conectores variados (admittedly, nevertheless, although) y cómo te sientes ahora con tu decisión. Usa verbos fuertes como decided y evita palabras vacías.

prompt.es: Reescribe las dos frases largas en versión concisa.

answer.text: Because it was raining, I decided to stay at home. Now I am saving money to study abroad.
accepted: Because it was raining, I decided to stay at home. Now I am saving money to study abroad.
Since it rained, I decided to stay home. Currently I am saving to study abroad.

feedback.es: Las dos frases se acortan cambiando la locución larga por because, made a decision por decided y in order to por to.

origin.text: Frases largas: 1) Due to the fact that it was raining, I made a decision to stay at home. 2) At this point in time, I am in the process of saving money in order to study abroad.

choices.text: Nevertheless, it is worth the cost.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué cambia la versión corta.

choices.text: It changes the reason for staying at home.
It adds a new fact about the weather.
It keeps the same meaning with fewer words.

origin.audio: The long version says, due to the fact that it was cold, I made a decision to stay at home. The short version says, because it was cold, I decided to stay home.

prompt.es: Completa la versión concisa: «Como llovía, me quedé en casa.»

feedback.es: Because sustituye a due to the fact that con la misma idea y menos palabras.
